description: This file defines classes and functions related to causal attention biases, including the CausalVariant enum, CausalBias class, and factory functions for creating upper-left and lower-right triangular causal biases used in scaled dot product attention mechanisms.

classes.name: CausalVariant
classes.description: Enum for causal variants used in attention mechanisms, with options UPPER_LEFT and LOWER_RIGHT.

classes.name: CausalBias
classes.description: A class representing causal attention biases, supporting upper-left and lower-right triangular masks, with methods for materialization and dispatching attention computations.

methods.name: causal_upper_left
methods.description: Creates an upper-left triangular causal bias tensor.

methods.name: causal_lower_right
methods.description: Creates a lower-right triangular causal bias tensor.
